tokenize_text: tokenize raw text into tokens with character-level ranges using SimpleFeaturizer
tokenize_batch_records: tokenize a batch of input records into OutputRecords with tokens and ranges
featurize_single_record: featurize a single input record by tokenizing it with optional sentence markers
featurize_batch_records: featurize a batch of input records into OutputRecords with tokens and characters
get_sentence_markers: get the configured sentence markers tuple from the SimpleFeaturizer config
